description: Calculates a Vedic (Jyotish) birth chart with the Swiss Ephemeris: sidereal zodiac with the Lahiri ayanamsa, whole-sign houses from the Lagna (Ascendant), the rashi, degree and house of the nine grahas (Sun to Saturn, Rahu as the mean node and Ketu opposite), and the nakshatra, pada and nakshatra lord of the Lagna and every graha, with the traditional symbol and deity of the Moon's nakshatra. Use it for questions like 'what is my nakshatra', 'my Vedic chart' or 'my rashi / Moon sign in Jyotish'. Pure calculation: no doshas, yogas or predictions. Birth data is used only for this calculation and is not stored or logged.

birth_time.description: Local birth time, 24-hour HH:MM. Omit if unknown: then houses, Ascendant and MC are not computed.
birth_time.title: Birth Time

lang.description: Language of the result: en or ru.
lang.title: Lang

place.description: Birth city, e.g. 'Chicago, Illinois, USA'. Used to look up coordinates and the time zone. Not needed if latitude/longitude are given.
place.title: Place

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the birth place, e.g. America/Chicago. Looked up from the place/coordinates when omitted.
timezone.title: Timezone

name: vedic_chart
